structured.answer: Open an account at Pasgot and buy the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 (4D) index fund (5139282). The page says this pair leaves the most, 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, and the fund's fees show as 0%.

stuck.why: It assumes 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 a month, and I couldn't see where to put in my own amounts
The coloured ticks only make sense through the key at the bottom, and I wasn't sure what 22,985 and 4,492 are compared against
The fee amounts are written under the bars, so I had to match colour squares to bar parts by looking back and forth
It mentions a price for students that isn't in the calculation, so I wasn't sure if Leumi would actually be cheaper for me

used: Big number 86,492 ₪ and 'פסגות · ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)'
Summary line: account choice 22,985 ₪ vs fund choice 4,492 ₪
Account list: Pasgot 86,492, Leumi 83,396, Interactive Brokers 83,141
skimmed: Fund list rows: Altshuler and iShares
not_found: A place to type my own monthly amount and starting sum
A plain explanation of whether small amounts are worth it
Whether the money is locked or I can take it out

findings.what: Every fund row repeats the same coloured tags ('קרן מחקה', 'צוברת', 'חשיפה לדולר'...), so I had to reread them on each row to find what's different
findings.where: Fund list under 'כל הקרנות על מדד S&P 500'

findings.what: Fee amounts are written apart from the coloured bar parts they belong to, so I had to match colours back and forth
The chart ticks' meaning is only in a colour key at the bottom, away from the lines
The deposit amounts are fixed (10,000 + 500 a month) and not obviously editable
The student price is mentioned but not counted, which might change the answer for me
Jargon is never explained: דמי משמרת, צוברת, מנוטרל מט"ח
